name: SCINTILLA Hub — the visual standard (V1, 3 Oct 2026)
measured_from: scintillahub.ai at origin/hub/release-20260923 9d2b1ca, headless Chromium, 1680 x 1050 and 1920 x 1080, every surface Alan uses (tools/walk.mjs, tools/count.mjs)
principle: A consistency pass, not a redesign: the Hub's look (monochrome black, cyan accent, letter-spaced uppercase labels) made the SAME everywhere. One value per role.
font: the mono stack already on the page (--mono: SF Mono, JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace)

type_scale.--sc-fs-1: 9px   — micro: the dots between tape items, pills
type_scale.--sc-fs-2: 10px  — tabs, section headers, table headers, footnotes and footers
type_scale.--sc-fs-5: 15px  — titles: the company name, the price

tab.ink: --sc-ink-dim; hover --sc-ink-2; active --sc-accent with a 2px inset underline

surface.background: --sc-surface #0F0F1A — the subtle hue behind the EARNINGS / ECONOMIC tape box, now on every boxed panel
surface.glow: --sc-glow inset 0 0 22px rgba(0,212,255,.05) — the tape box's inner glow

border: --sc-border .8px solid rgba(0,212,255,.34) — the cyan hairline, the only border on a boxed panel
divider: --sc-line #1A1A2A — the only line inside a panel (rows, header rows, the chart's edges)

tab.style: mono · 10px · 400 · .18em · uppercase · padding 10px 6px · no box, no radius, no underline on links · dim; hover brighter; active cyan text with a 2px inset cyan underline
carried_by: the master tabs (.sc-mtab, buttons and the ALLOCATION / STATION / TREE links)
the chart toolbar: ◂ BOARD, COHORT ▾, 1h 4h 1D 3D 1W, CLOUDS, EXPAND

button: a boxed control that is not a tab: the hairline border (--sc-border), square, no fill, dim ink; on = cyan ink

company_view.note: the chart (with its toolbar) and the tab area under it each take half the panel's height on a desk; EXPAND keeps its side-by-side grid, the phone its stack

page_specs.where: ONE per tab or page, at its bottom, closed by default, footnote type
page_specs.what_moves: explanatory sentences and source notes (marked .sc-spec, swept by the sc-pagespecs-20261003 script); numbers, units and labels stay

lives_in: index.html, <style id="sc-design-standard-20261003"> (last in the cascade) and <script id="sc-pagespecs-20261003">
